headline: Feds claim Akademiks knew about Lul Pab murder and couldn’t even look Durk in the eye
body: Trap Lore Ross reports federal authorities allege Akademiks knew about Lul Pab's murder but failed to maintain eye contact with Lil Durk during an interview. The claim states they 'knew Durk was admitting murder' in the federal investigation. The post, with 2,320 likes and 269 comments, suggests a significant shift in the case's narrative.
